resources.string: Add your API key in Settings to get started.
Type any message, choose a mode and tap Generate.
ProChat works inside WeChat, WhatsApp, Gmail and other apps. See the Guide tab for the quick steps.

ProChat helps you write polished, polite and professional messages in any chat app: WeChat, WhatsApp, Gmail, Messages and more.\n\nWrite the way you normally do, even quickly in Roman Urdu with spelling mistakes, and ProChat turns it into a message you\'d be proud to send. It can also write replies for you and translate into English or Chinese.
Your message, polished and professional, in the same language. Right after ENG, 中文 or Urdu, Pro polishes that translation.
A professional reply to a message you received.
Your message, polished and translated into English.
Your message, polished and translated into Chinese, with pinyin to help you read it. Only the Chinese characters are copied.
Your message, polished in Roman Urdu (copied by default), with the Urdu script version below: tap it to copy the script instead.
Type your message. For a reply, long-press the message you received.
In the menu, tap ProChat, ProChat Reply, ProChat ENG, ProChat 中文 or ProChat Urdu. Tap ⋮ if you don\'t see them.
Tap Replace (or Copy for a reply) and send.
Select your message (or the message you received) and tap Copy.
Swipe down from the top of the screen and tap the ProChat tile.
Choose a mode. The result is copied for you automatically.
Long-press the message box, tap Paste and send.
No tile yet? Tap the button below. You can also long-press the ProChat app icon and choose \"Polish copied text\".

ProChat needs no special permissions. It only sees text you select or copy, at the moment you use it, and sends it only to the AI provider you chose in Settings. The microphone is used only while you\'re speaking a voice message, and the recording is deleted right after it\'s sent to Google Gemini. Your API key is stored only on this phone.
For Google Gemini. Faster settings answer sooner; Best writes the finest messages.
Best: finest writing, a little slower
Adds the ProChat tile to your quick-settings panel (swipe down from the top of the screen).
Swipe down quick settings, tap the pencil (edit) icon, and drag \"ProChat\" into your tiles.
Tile added. Swipe down quick settings to find \"ProChat\".
The ProChat tile is already in your quick settings.
ProChat %1$s\nProfessional messages for WeChat, WhatsApp and every chat app.
Nothing copied yet. Copy some text and tap the ProChat tile again, or tap 🎤 Speak.
Ready. Copy a new message and tap the ProChat tile, or tap 🎤 Speak to say it.
✓ Copied. Long-press the message box and tap Paste.
Listening… speak your message, then tap Stop.
I didn\'t catch that. Tap 🎤 Speak and talk a little longer.
The microphone is busy or unavailable. Please try again.
ProChat needs the microphone to hear your voice. Allow it when asked, or in Settings → Apps → ProChat → Permissions.
Recording stopped because you left ProChat. Tap 🎤 Speak to try again.

Speak instead of typing, in Urdu, English, Chinese or a mix. ProChat listens and writes it in the mode you choose (Pro, ENG, 中文 or Urdu), then copies it for you. Spoken Urdu is written in Roman Urdu. Voice uses Google Gemini.
Swipe down and tap the ProChat Voice tile (or tap 🎤 Speak in any ProChat pop-up).
Speak your message, then tap Stop.
The result is copied. Long-press the message box, tap Paste and send.
